up: Retrieve all unique compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4417631'. Return the compound ChEMBL ID and preferred name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4417631'
